title: Corner option: C1 moving junctions render the author's cubic acceleration step as a jerk-limited ramp (RFC-105 planner option, A/B against continuous)
description: Operator ruling 2026-10-05: both renderings until the tuner proves which earns it. Config::corner = Continuous (default, today's behavior) | Cubic: at an authored C1 knot with nonzero velocity, the acceleration on each side is the C1 Hermite cubic's own at that knot (left: from the incoming span, right: from the outgoing span), joined by one constant-jerk phase of |a_right - a_left| / jmax seconds centered on the knot; the knot is hit at its time with its velocity; the head piece targets the ramp's start state and the next piece starts from its end state. Referee and spends apply to the head; the ramp is legal by construction once |a| <= amax (clamp the side accelerations to amax, EndVelClamped-style report). Fingerprint must not change under the default.
close_reason: Landed as Config::corner with a test pinning the side accelerations to the cubic's own and the ramp jerk to jmax; default Continuous, fingerprint unchanged
